name: tab.setValue
code: var nameId=Number(ax.match(/(\d+) text field[^\n]*Description: Name,/)[1]); await tab.setValue(nameId,"original typed");

name: tab.typeText
code: await tab.getAXState({emit:false}); await tab.typeText(nameId," added"); nodeRepl.write(await tab.playwright.evaluate(()=>document.querySelector("#name").value));

name: tab.click
code: ax=await tab.getAXState({emit:false,disableDiffing:true}); var incrementId=Number(ax.match(/(\d+) button[^\n]*Increment/)[1]); await tab.click(incrementId); nodeRepl.write(await tab.playwright.locator("#count").innerText());

name: tab.drag
code: await tab.playwright.getByText("Drag me",{exact:true}).click(); var rects=await tab.playwright.evaluate(()=>["drag","drop"].map(id=>{const r=document.getElementById(id).getBoundingClientRect();return [r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2]})); await tab.drag(rects[0],rects[1]);

name: webmcp.tools.call
code: const wm=await tab.capabilities.get("webmcp"); const tools=await wm.fetchTools(); var toolName=tools.description().match(/"name": "([^"]+)"/)[1]; nodeRepl.write(await tools.call(toolName,{text:"bridge-native-WebMCP-verified"}));
